panel.empty: No setting item is visible right now.
panel.readonlyTip: SiYuan is in read-only or publish mode, so settings cannot be saved
feature.logOutput.title: Detailed log output
feature.logOutput.description: Writes the plugin's detailed logs to the console, one line per event with an INFO / WARN / ERROR level and a [some-settings-siyuan__featureID] prefix. Off by default; while off only a single load hint is printed.
feature.logOutput.enabledTip: Logs are written in English for troubleshooting; turn this off to keep the console quiet
feature.codeBlockLangEmpty.title: Never remember the code language
feature.codeBlockLangEmpty.description: New code blocks always start with an empty language instead of reusing the language picked last time.
feature.assetInfoMenu.title: File size and metadata in the asset menu
feature.assetInfoMenu.description: Shows the file size, image dimensions, type and modified time of a workspace asset in the menu of images, audio, video and iframe blocks and of inline links pointing at an asset.
feature.assetsNewFile.title: Create a file in assets from the slash menu
feature.assetsNewFile.description: Type a slash command in a document to create an empty file with any extension under assets/; the file name gets a note ID appended and a link is inserted at the caret.
feature.assetsNewFile.tip: Enter a file name (any extension). The file is saved under the current notebook's assets/ directory, a SiYuan note ID is appended to its name, and a link is inserted at the caret.
feature.assetsNewFile.invalid: The name must not be empty or contain / or \
feature.assetsNewFile.failed: Could not create the file. Please try again
feature.bookmarkLastPosition.title: Jump to the last position when a bookmark opens a note
feature.bookmarkLastPosition.description: Opens a whole-document bookmark through the same path as the document tree, restoring the last reading position; bookmarks on a block are left alone.
feature.recordingWindow.title: A floating window instead of the recording notice
feature.recordingWindow.description: Replaces the notice SiYuan shows while recording with a floating window that shows the elapsed time and stops the recording from there.
feature.exitConfirm.title: Ask before quitting
feature.exitConfirm.description: Asks before SiYuan quits: the Quit item in the main menu and closing the window when SiYuan is set to quit on close; quitting from the desktop tray menu does not ask.
feature.modalBlur.title: Blur behind modals
feature.modalBlur.description: Applies a backdrop blur to the dialog scrim so the editor behind it is softened while the dialog itself stays sharp.
feature.docTreeOpenedAccent.title: Accent for the opened note
feature.docTreeOpenedAccent.description: Draws an accent bar on the left edge of the currently opened note in the document tree; the colour is configurable.
feature.docTreeOpenedAccent.colorTip: Leave empty to follow the SiYuan theme primary; any CSS colour such as #rrggbb, rgb() or var(--b3-theme-primary) works
feature.docTreeTitleMarkdown.title: Inline Markdown in document tree titles
feature.docTreeTitleMarkdown.description: Renders bold, italic, bold italic, strikethrough, highlight, superscript, subscript and inline code in notebook and document titles of the document tree.
feature.tabTitleMarkdown.title: Inline Markdown in tab titles
feature.tabTitleMarkdown.description: Renders inline Markdown in tab titles: the desktop tab bar with its dropdown list, and the mobile tab overview.
feature.headingLevelIcon.title: Heading level in the title icon
feature.headingLevelIcon.description: Uses the H1-H6 icons for heading blocks in the reference list and the search panel, with the level drawn in the bottom right corner.
feature.bazaarCustomIcon.title: Custom icons for marketplace packages
feature.bazaarCustomIcon.description: Replaces the icon of any installed package in Settings - Marketplace - Downloaded. The icons live in the plugin's own directory, affect this client only and sync with SiYuan.
feature.bazaarCustomIcon.manageTip: Manages icons for installed marketplace packages by author/package name; saving an icon turns the feature on, and the switch afterwards only controls whether the icons are applied.
feature.bazaarCustomIcon.notice: Icon files live under icons/ in the plugin storage directory, named "author__package.ext". They never modify the package itself or appear on anyone else's client.
feature.bazaarCustomIcon.tip: Pick any image (SVG and base64 are supported) to replace an installed package's icon. Changes apply immediately and turn the feature on; restoring the default deletes the image you saved.
feature.bazaarCustomIcon.empty: There are no marketplace packages to manage.
feature.bazaarCustomIcon.failed: Could not read the installed marketplace packages.
feature.bazaarCustomIcon.invalid: That is not a usable image (PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP / SVG / AVIF / BMP / ICO, up to 4 MiB)
feature.bazaarCustomIcon.savedAndEnabled: Icon saved; the feature was turned on
feature.bazaarCustomIcon.base64Tip: Paste a complete data URI (recommended, e.g. data:image/png;base64,…) or bare base64; raw SVG text is accepted too.
feature.hideBazaarDownloadedDonate.title: Hide donation buttons in downloaded marketplace lists
feature.hideBazaarDownloadedDonate.descr: Hides the heart-shaped donation button on package cards in every package type and the update list under Settings - Marketplace - Downloaded. Ratings, settings, uninstall, switches and package details stay unchanged.
feature.bazaarAuthorBlocklist.title: Block marketplace packages by author
feature.bazaarAuthorBlocklist.descriptio: Hides packages in the online marketplace lists by the author field of the marketplace index. Only the five online list tabs are affected; downloaded and update lists stay unchanged.
feature.bazaarAuthorBlocklist.authorsTip: One author per line, matched exactly against the author field in the marketplace index (case-insensitive, no substring matching). Blank lines are ignored.
feature.bazaarAuthorBlocklist.authorsPla: One author per line, e.g. wilsons
feature.bazaarAuthorBlocklist.allBlocked: All {count} packages are hidden by the author blocklist
feature.mobileDockBlur.title: Blur behind the mobile dock bar
feature.mobileDockBlur.description: Turns the floating mobile dock bar into frosted glass so the document blurs underneath while scrolling.
feature.mobileDocTreeTitleSize.title: Mobile document tree title size back to 3.8.9
feature.mobileDocTreeTitleSize.descripti: SiYuan 3.8.10 enlarged the title text of the mobile document tree; this scales it back to the 3.8.9 proportion and keeps following SiYuan's own font size setting.
feature.mobileBarAnimation.title: Smoother mobile bars
feature.mobileBarAnimation.description: Adds a smooth transition to the show/hide behaviour of the mobile top bar, breadcrumb and floating dock bar; the dock bar only switches between fully shown and fully hidden.
feature.mobileSyncButton.title: Always show Sync on mobile
feature.mobileSyncButton.description: Keeps the Sync button visible in the mobile top-right corner.
feature.hideMobileExit.title: Hide the mobile Quit button
feature.hideMobileExit.description: Hides the icon-only Quit button in the mobile side panel.
feature.hideAgentWelcomeExamples.title: Hide the agent's suggested prompts
feature.hideAgentWelcomeExamples.descrip: Hides the example prompts on the agent panel's new-session screen, so an accidental click cannot start a conversation and spend tokens.
feature.agentEnterToSend.title: Send the agent message with Enter
feature.agentEnterToSend.description: Sends the agent message with Enter; use Ctrl+Enter or Shift+Enter to insert a line break (Cmd+Enter on macOS).
feature.agentThinkingStickyHeader.title: Pin the agent thinking header
feature.agentThinkingStickyHeader.descri: Pins the "Thought for N s" header of an expanded thinking card to the top of the panel, so a long thought can be collapsed at any time.
feature.agentToolCallDetail.title: Details for the agent's tool calls
feature.agentToolCallDetail.description: Tool calls in a thinking card are no longer just a name: each one is followed by the arguments it ran with, and hovering shows the full arguments and the result.
feature.refCrumbsGuide.title: Guide to the Ref Crumbs plugin
feature.refCrumbsGuide.description: Points to another plugin by the same author, and opens its settings panel or its marketplace page from here.
feature.refCrumbsGuide.notice:
Ref Crumbs is another plugin by the same author: it appends the heading chain (h2-h6) of every result in the block reference search list.
This row only points you there. It changes nothing in your notes, and whether to install it is up to you.
feature.refCrumbsGuide.actionTip: Opens its settings panel when the plugin is enabled here, otherwise its page in the marketplace.
feature.refCrumbsGuide.bazaarUnavailable: The marketplace is turned off on this device, so its page cannot be opened
feature.dailyNoteDirect.title: Create the daily note directly
feature.dailyNoteDirect.description: Creates the daily note in the notebook chosen below instead of asking which notebook to use.
feature.dailyNoteDirect.notebookTip: Only currently opened notebooks are listed; choosing None keeps SiYuan's own prompt
feature.newDocFixedTarget.title: Create new documents at a fixed location
feature.newDocFixedTarget.description: Creates ordinary new documents at the root of a chosen notebook or under a chosen document, whichever native entry starts them (menu, tab bar, empty page, search, shortcut, or command palette); child documents, daily notes, reference creation, and the slash-menu entry that creates a document as a block reference keep SiYuan's own behavior.
feature.newDocFixedTarget.targetTip: A notebook ID creates at its root; a document ID creates a child document. Leave empty to keep SiYuan's default behavior
feature.newDocFixedTarget.invalid: The target ID is invalid, its notebook is not open, or the document does not exist
feature.newDocFixedTarget.failed: Could not create a document at the configured location
feature.firstDocIcon.title: Fixed first document icon
feature.firstDocIcon.description: Writes the emoji below the first time a document gets an icon, then opens the native picker as usual.
feature.firstDocIcon.emojiTip: Enter a single emoji; leave empty to write no icon
feature.externalLinkConfirm.title: Confirm before opening a web link
feature.externalLinkConfirm.description: Asks before opening an http/https link and shows the full URL.
feature.externalLinkConfirm.prompt: The following link will be opened in your browser:
feature.kernelReconnectButton.title: Reconnect button on the disconnect panel
feature.kernelReconnectButton.descriptio: Adds a Reconnect button to the kernel-disconnected panel: it probes whether the kernel is back and then reloads the frontend to reconnect — SiYuan gives plugins no way to reconnect the kernel directly, so the whole interface refreshes once.
feature.kernelReconnectButton.label: Reconnect now
feature.kernelReconnectButton.offline: The kernel is still unreachable; please try again in a moment
feature.kernelAutoReconnect.title: Automatic reconnect after a disconnect
feature.kernelAutoReconnect.description: After the kernel connection drops, probes the kernel using the count and interval below and reloads the frontend to reconnect as soon as it answers: the whole interface refreshes once, exactly as with Reconnect now.
feature.kernelAutoReconnect.attemptsTip: Set to 0 to disable automatic attempts
feature.deepseekBalance.title: DeepSeek balance in the agent panel
feature.deepseekBalance.description: With the official api.deepseek.com DeepSeek model it reads the API key configured under Settings - AI, polls the balance on the interval below and shows it below the agent panel composer.
feature.deepseekBalance.intervalTip: Time between two queries, 1 second minimum
feature.deepseekBalance.label: DeepSeek balance:
feature.deepseekBalance.noProvider: No enabled DeepSeek model on api.deepseek.com (enable one under Settings - AI)
feature.deepseekBalance.failed: Could not fetch the DeepSeek balance
feature.deepseekBalance.empty: The API returned no balance information
feature.deepseekBalance.insufficient: Balance too low to keep calling the API
feature.ossUsage.title: Aliyun OSS bucket usage
feature.ossUsage.description: Adds a usage button to SiYuan's S3 storage settings that queries the bucket's storage and object count with the credentials saved there; it stays hidden unless the endpoint is Aliyun OSS. The button does not appear yet while the desktop app uses an independent settings window; please wait for a later update.
feature.ossUsage.networkTip: The kernel sends this request for the plugin, but it never got out: check the network connection and the endpoint.
feature.ossUsage.missingConfig: The S3 settings are incomplete; fill in and save these fields first: {fields}
feature.mobileRefPanelHeight.title: Taller mobile candidate panel
feature.mobileRefPanelHeight.description: Raises the height of the mobile candidate panel used for reference search and friends to a share of the viewport, without passing the bottom of the visible area.
feature.mobileRefPanelHeight.maxHeightTi: Share of the viewport height; the real height is also capped by the space between the panel and the bottom of the screen
feature.mobileSelectNative.title: Native SiYuan style for mobile dropdowns
feature.mobileSelectNative.description: Opening a dropdown on mobile shows SiYuan's own menu and still fires change on selection.
feature.mobileLongpressMenuLabel.title: Labels in the mobile long-press menu
feature.mobileLongpressMenuLabel.descrip: Adds text to the icon-only buttons in the mobile long-press menu; the back button keeps its icon only.
feature.mobileBlockIconAlways.title: Keep the block icon visible on mobile
feature.mobileBlockIconAlways.descriptio: Keeps the block icon visible while a block is being operated on mobile; clicking it still opens the native menu.
feature.inlineCodeCopy.title: Copy button for inline code
feature.inlineCodeCopy.description: Adds a copy button to inline code, shown on hover, always, or not at all.
feature.inlineCodeCopy.label: Copy inline code
feature.desktopCommandPanelSlim.title: Slimmer desktop command panel
feature.desktopCommandPanelSlim.descript: Shrinks the desktop command panel to a share of SiYuan's native width.
feature.desktopCommandPanelSlim.widthTip: Share of SiYuan's native width (80vw); 50% equals 40vw
feature.codeSnippetHighlight.title: Syntax highlighting for snippets
feature.codeSnippetHighlight.description: Colours the snippet editor under Settings using CSS/JS syntax, following the selected code theme. It does not apply yet while the desktop app uses an independent settings window; please wait for a later update.
feature.devtoolsHotkey.title: F12 toggles the developer tools on desktop
feature.devtoolsHotkey.description: Presses F12 on desktop to open or close the developer tools, the same entry as the one in the status bar context menu.
feature.mobileConsoleLog.title: Console log viewer
feature.mobileConsoleLog.description: Collects console output from the moment the plugin loads and shows the full log in a dialog.
feature.mobileConsoleLog.capacityTip: The oldest entries are dropped once this is exceeded
feature.mobileConsoleLog.openTip: Read every entry, copy the whole log, or clear it
feature.configTransfer.title: Import and export this plugin's configuration
feature.configTransfer.description: Writes every configuration file in this plugin's storage directory into one JSON document, and reads such a document back.
feature.configTransfer.exportTip: Opens every configuration file in this plugin's storage directory as one read-only JSON document, ready to copy.
feature.configTransfer.importTip: Paste a JSON document exported by this plugin; every entry is written back to its own configuration file, even for a feature this client does not load, and the frontend reloads afterwards.
feature.configTransfer.copyFailed: Could not write to the clipboard; select the text and copy it manually
feature.configTransfer.invalidJson: That is not valid JSON; nothing was imported
feature.configTransfer.invalidShape: That JSON is not a plugin configuration: it must map feature ids to configuration objects
feature.configTransfer.imported: Imported {count} configuration file(s), ignored {skipped} unrecognised entry/entries
feature.clearConfig.title: Clear this plugin's configuration
feature.clearConfig.description: Deletes every configuration file in this plugin's storage directory, putting all features back into their just-installed state.
feature.clearConfig.tip: Deletes every configuration file in this plugin's storage directory, including those left by features this client does not load or by retired features, and then reloads the frontend. This cannot be undone.
feature.clearConfig.confirmText: This deletes every configuration file in this plugin's storage directory and then reloads the frontend. It cannot be undone.
feature.pluginReminder.title: About this plugin
feature.pluginReminder.description: What this plugin is, its current version, and where to report problems.
feature.pluginReminder.notice:
This plugin is built and maintained by an individual. It is not an official SiYuan feature and is not part of the SiYuan project itself.
Every feature is off by default and is enabled one by one; the plugin works by taking over SiYuan's own settings entry and parts of its interface behaviour, so individual features may break after a major SiYuan update, and plugins that touch the same part of the interface can interfere with each other.
Current version: v{version}. When something misbehaves, reload the plugin or turn the related feature off first; if the problem remains, please report it in the repository.
GitHub repository: {repo}
